description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this information resource. Coverage is county roads or the specific site named below. The Vision Zero Crash Dashboard presents fatal and serious-injury crashes on county roads from 2018 to 2023, together with high-injury and high-risk network outputs prepared by Toole Design Group for the spring 2025 Vision Zero Action Plan. Crash records originate from WSDOT police traffic collision reports. The source-defined information supports resilience analysis for these infrastructure systems. This resource includes locally produced road-risk analysis outputs in addition to an extract of state crash records. The numerical data, modelling method and completeness were not inspected. The provider states that safety material has statutory restrictions relating to court proceedings, and that information can contain errors or be incomplete. Access is through public county catalogue entries and ArcGIS metadata. The licence is not stated. Reuse is subject to linked county GIS terms; the terms PDF was not opened and charges are not stated. A limitation is that metadata review does not establish current operational availability, accuracy or complete attribute coverage. No data export, feature query or application payload was read. A regular update frequency is not stated. Related sources are identified in the record notes where a concrete connection is established.
